decision.rationale: The saved official Mathematics homepage identifies undergraduate/graduate academic guidance, research fields, outreach, memorials and award announcements. Use these observed sections with an academic department baseline.
evidence: https://www.math.ubc.ca/ | 3bfef60f9a53fb504199437458dc4c685b590fcbd2c5f808800f38ad55805014 | Undergraduates: taking courses in the Math Department; Graduate Students: information for current and future students.
https://www.math.ubc.ca/research | Research Fields; graduate school or postdoctoral mentoring.
https://www.math.ubc.ca/news-events/awards | Awards won by faculty members and students.

rules.rationale: The homepage explicitly links a research-fields section.
Memorials recount former faculty lives and contributions.
News-events and won-award reports describe announcements rather than open funding calls.
The homepage describes educational outreach for schoolchildren.

fallback.rationale: The official Mathematics department supplies academic program, course and discipline information.
